newsitem.title: UK: IBCA maintains Dixons Group ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA maintains Dixons Group ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Thursday it maintained Dixons Group Plc's A minus long-term and A2 short-term ratings.
"After several years of difficult trading in the early 1990s, strong sales of consumer electronics in the last 18 months have driven sales and earnings growth at Dixons," IBCA said in a statement.

Competition remains intense but the strength of the group's brands and the diversity of its trading formats, where it is present in both the High Street and out-of-town, have allowed Dixons to meet the recovery in demand for its more traditional white and brown products, IBCA said.
It has also been able to capitalise on the rapid pace of growth in the sale of mobile telephony products, PCS and associated computer based products.

"PC World, Dixons' specialist computer superstore chain, more than doubled sales and although much of the growth came from new store openings, like-for-like sales growth of 30 percent underlines the growing importance of software upgrades and systems enhancements," IBCA said.
Operating cashflow generated is more than sufficient to meet forecast levels of capital expenditure, both on further store openings and improving the efficiency of distribution, it said.
"Surplus cash will continue to enhance the year end cash position while financial coverages will rise further in line with improved earnings and lower finance costs," IBCA said.
